scope: Read-only review of new Reader, conservative bridge and independently authored controls, including delayed acceptable-array allocation.
findings: Strict syntax controls re-pin mutated raw bytes to reach the parser; stale-pin failures are separate.
U/null, ambiguity T/F retention, known zero-weight truth and train-loss versus validation-evaluation masks are separate axes.
Every row is checked for declared family/group role conflicts and common policy/role pins before selection.
SelectedAuditIndices preserves original audit indexes; tests also compare explicit labels, weights, refs and denominators.
Acceptable backing storage is allocated only upon a selected positive; nonnil slicing and 60-by-8 bounds hold.
Benchmark fixture construction is outside the timer; Project payload excludes audit storage, scratch and RSS.
limitations: This is source review, not a second execution of Root QA.
Zero returned rejection counters do not independently instrument hidden feature calls.
Opaque binding equality does not interpret evidence or prove rights, semantic qualification or transitive ancestry.
